title: Moscone.X (Series 19) — Yerba Buena Gardens
summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO cell on the green roof above Moscone Center. Six districts map the DAO workflow — charter, research, proposals, operations, progress — with agents operating and people deciding.

buildings.name: Charter Pavilion
buildings.use: Charter display and contribution model exhibits

props: brass compass rose inlaid in lawn

buildings.name: Synthesis Lab Dome
buildings.use: Evidence monitoring and research synthesis workspace

districts.real_anchor: Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Fountain area

buildings.name: Drafting Pavilion
buildings.use: Proposal drafting desks for human review

districts.real_anchor: Yerba Buena Gardens upper terrace overlook

court.name: The Decision Court
court.style: Open-air circular amphitheater of stone tiers around a still reflecting pool
court.why_here: Mirrors the DAO principle: agents draft and present in the open, but the final ring — the vote — is reserved for humans, steps from the Proposal Forum.

quests.title: Charter Orientation
steps: Read the charter stele and mission wall
Log your contributor name in the ledger
Ask Progress Tracker which outcomes are measured
Note one outcome on the milestone map
Report back to Charter Hall

quests.title: From Evidence to Draft
steps: Collect a summary from Evidence Monitor
Have Research Synthesis Agent brief you
Deliver the brief to the Proposal & Grant Drafter
Review the draft at a human review desk
Place the draft in the human vote queue

quests.title: Route the Working Group
steps: Read a task from the kanban board
Ask Task Router to assign a working group
Get collaborator leads from Collaborator Scout
Confirm the group's evidence needs with Evidence Monitor
Mark the task complete on the board

quests.title: Outcome Milestone Walk
steps: Check the outcome dials with Progress Tracker
Identify the lagging metric
Request a proposal draft addressing it
Present the draft at the Decision Court
Watch humans cast the final vote (do not vote yourself)

quests.title: Guard the Human-Reserved Ring
steps: Recite the six human-reserved actions at the Mission Wall
Spot three actions only humans may take
Ask Task Router how agents hand off decisions
Log the handoff protocol at the Charter Hall kiosk
